## Standing operator rules
- “Goal for this session: replace the hand-rolled retry loop in ledgerly/sync/client.py with tenacity.” Superseded by: “Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint. New priority: the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py is double-counting refunds; fix that.”
- Run “Monthly payroll run 2025-03” in between other work, executing these steps in order, one at a time: `payrollctl runs validate --run payroll-2025-03 --period 2025-03 --strict`; `payrollctl payroll compute --run payroll-2025-03 --period 2025-03 --currency USD --version 3`; `payrollctl payroll review payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --show exceptions --confirm`; `payrollctl payroll approve payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --approver finance.ops --scope full`; `payrollctl payments create-batch payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --funding operating-usd --submit`; `payrollctl payments approve batch-20250328-1842 --approver treasury.ops --control-total 986442.17`; `payrollctl payments submit batch-20250328-1842 --execution-date 2025-03-28 --confirm-submit --request-id run-20250328-payroll`; `payrollctl notifications send payroll-2025-03 --channel email --template payroll-paid-v4 --audience all --request-id notify-20250328-payroll`.
- “Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures.

- Payroll IDs: `payroll-2025-03`, `batch-20250328-1842`, `operating-usd`, control total `986442.17`, version `3`.
- Current request context variable: `current_request_id`.
- SQLAlchemy: `DeclarativeBase`, `session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)`, timezone-aware invoice timestamps.
